prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Paper & Pulp, Company Size: 420 employees, Pain Points: Water discharge exceeds BOD limits, chemical handling procedures outdated, no emergency drills conducted this year, waste segregation issues on production floor

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Low", "gaps": "Exceeding BOD limits in water discharge, outdated chemical handling procedures, lack of emergency drills, and waste segregation issues on the production floor indicate significant gaps in environmental management, safety protocols, and operational procedures.", "recommendations": "Implement an Environmental Management System (EMS) per ISO 14001, update chemical handling procedures per OSHA and ISO standards, conduct regular emergency drills per ISO 45001, and establish clear waste segregation protocols on the production floor with employee training.", "standards": "ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 9001 (Quality Management)"}
